verdict.rationale: bizfile's User Access feature is a first-party mechanism that lets an entity control who is authorized to submit online filings on its behalf, and it will be required for Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026. That is a sanctioned delegation rail, but the evidence never says that third-party providers, registered agents or designees can be granted this access, nor how they are onboarded or scoped. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that external providers or registered agents can be authorized, details of delegate roles and permission scope, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: User Access allows the entity to control who is authorized to submit online filings on behalf of the entity.
Effective August 1, 2026, web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings.
Establishing User Access will help in preventing unauthorized submissions or filings on your entity's record.
